newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCorp, Energy deal seen shortly-sources.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCorp, Energy deal seen shortly-sources.

text.p: PacifiCorp is working to complete financing and is likely to announce a nearly $6 billion cash takeover offer for Britain's Energy Group Ltd as early as Friday morning.
Sources close to the deal talks said they expect an outside date for the announcement of early next week, barring any unforeseen issues. The announcement is pending financing arrangements.
PacifiCorp's takeover of Britain's Energy Group would create a three-continent energy giant, each company fortifying the other's marketing, generating and coal mining units.
The boards of both companies have voted in favor of the deal, which values Energy at 20 percent above the company's recent 580-pence share price in London, one of the sources said.
